title: Who will win the 2026 California gubernatorial election?
reasoning: June primary is settled: Democrat Xavier Becerra and Republican Steve Hilton advanced; Bianco, Porter, and Steyer were eliminated and cannot win. California is deep blue and elects Democrats statewide, so Becerra is the heavy favorite over Hilton.

title: Which party will win the 2026 Maine gubernatorial election?
reasoning: Open Democratic-held seat in a Democratic-leaning state decided by plurality, but former GOP chair Rick Bennett is a formidable independent who could win or split the field. Democrat favored, with a meaningful tail for Bennett (Other) and a weaker Republican.

title: Which party will win the 2026 Alaska gubernatorial election?
reasoning: Open seat under ranked-choice voting; prediction markets put Democrats Begich (30%) and Kreiss-Tomkins (16%) ahead of Republican Wilson (25%) and Taylor (7%), with independent Walker around 6%. A red-leaning state but strong Democratic candidates and a Democratic national environment make it roughly a coin flip favoring the Democrat.

title: What will be the Republican advantage (or disadvantage) vs Democrats in the House of Repre
reasoning: Strong out-party midterm environment (D+5 generic ballot, low presidential approval) plus markets pricing ~80% Democratic House makes a Democratic majority likely; median around a Dem edge of ~12 seats (GOP minus Dem ~ -12). Wide interval reflects the historically tight modern House map and possibility of a narrow GOP hold.

title: Which party will control the US Congress following the 2026 midterm elections?
reasoning: Markets price a Democratic sweep at ~44% and Republican-Senate/Democratic-House at ~35%, with a Republican sweep ~18%; House likely flips to Democrats while the Senate map favors Republicans. The split where Democrats hold the Senate but lose the House is near-impossible given correlated environment.

title: What will be the Republican advantage (or disadvantage) vs Democrats in the Senate after t

Median lands around R+2 (51-49 R), with the distribution straddling Democratic control on a strong-environment night and a status-quo R+6 on the upside.
